criterion.name: Autopoietic Memory
criterion.statement: The conversation corpus engine must be capable of ingesting transcripts from its own operational sessions as corpus artifacts, closing the self-referential feedback loop.

evidence.requirement: Functional Adapter — import adapter exists for at least one AI session transcript format (e.g., SpecStory, Claude Code).
Self-Referential Corpus — at least one corpus consisting of engine development sessions exists in the system registry.
Quality Gate Compliance — the self-referential corpus passes all 8 CCE evaluation gates (stability, retrieval, answer accuracy).

criterion.measurement: Run `cce evaluation run --root /path/to/self-referential-corpus`; all 8 regression gates must return PASS status.
criterion.gap: SpecStory import adapter (import_specstory_session_corpus.py) does not exist. No self-referential corpus currently registered. Criterion enters the scorecard as NOT_MET if ratified.

amendment_route.human_gate: Omega amendments require (1) documented rationale with source citation, (2) human approval by @4444j99, (3) propagation to all affected documents (per docs/memory/constitution.md, Amendments). Agents may prepare and route but may not attest ratification.
